subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, holding a microphone
initial_pose: standing turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly forward, left hand holding the microphone at chest height, right arm extended down to the right with the open palm facing up, closed-lip smile
description: the smile suddenly drops: with a blank, cold face he stares straight into the camera and speaks slowly in a low voice, the mouth opening and closing in small slow movements; the head tilts slightly down and stays still; the free right hand slowly raises its index finger and points at the camera; then the smile returns as he settles back into the starting pose
